name: IPTV passthrough
description: Live channels from an IPTV playlist (M3U) and its XMLTV guide, added alongside your own channels: same channel list, same guide in Jellyfin. Streams are passed through without re-encoding where possible; HLS and MPEG-TS sources both work. Free channels from iptv-org's playlists can be picked by country, category or language, and guides made with iptv-org/epg.
author: SchedularrTV
lowPowerNotice: passed-through channels cost almost nothing. Keep passthrough on (re-encoding is done in software), and on boards with 4 GB or less prefer the provider's XMLTV guide to the iptv-org grabber, which runs Node.js with up to 2 GB of memory.

settings.label: ffmpeg
settings.description: Relays each stream (and turns HLS into MPEG-TS for ErsatzTV). Leave empty to use the ffmpeg set under App settings.

settings.label: Stream address
settings.description: How ErsatzTV reaches this scheduler. Leave empty unless ErsatzTV runs on another machine or in a container.

settings.label: Refresh playlists and guides every (hours)
settings.description: How often each playlist and guide is downloaded again (1 to 48).

settings.label: iptv-org guides: grab every (hours)
settings.description: For providers whose guide is made with iptv-org/epg (2 to 168). Grabbing scrapes each channel's listings site, so a few times a day is plenty.

settings.label: iptv-org guides: days of listings
settings.description: 1 to 14. More days take longer to grab; the guide is grabbed again well before they run out.
settings.lowPowerNote: Keep this at 1 or 2 here: each day is more listings to fetch and hold in memory.

settings.label: iptv-org guides: requests at once
settings.description: 1 to 20. Higher grabs faster, but some listings sites block busy callers.
settings.lowPowerNote: Keep this at 3 or fewer here.

settings.label: Node.js (for iptv-org guides)
settings.description: Leave empty to use the Node.js installed on this computer (20 or newer), or else download a copy just for this plugin.

settings.label: Keep a stream open after its last viewer (seconds)
settings.description: Holds the provider connection over programme changes, when ErsatzTV briefly reconnects. Some providers allow only one connection at a time.
